digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, model escalation and sizing
propositions: For a non-Anthropic-family primary model not present in MODEL_LADDER, substring-matching in models_at_or_above falls through and returns the full ladder instead of the primary alone, causing escalation to downgrade to smaller windows and cross provider families

largest_window_tokens returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] (1000000 tokens) for an unlocated primary instead of a conservative value, overstating available context and causing under-blocking in plan-review sizing
The prerequisite-coverage escalation path calls models_at_or_above and takes ladder[0], duplicating the downgrade defect without editing prerequisites.py itself
Pass-1 escalation assigns returned ladder names directly to run config, so an unlocated primary's first escalation is claude-haiku-4-5 with a smaller window than the operator's configured model

The fix changes models_at_or_above to return [model] for truthy-but-unlocated primaries and largest_window_tokens to return the ladder minimum instead of maximum, preserving single-criterion retry while stopping before cross-family rungs
